conditioning: Frozen program R15_v2 on region F_b011_s030__reference: pointwise operator, unit_rms controller, bridge representation, window [0.1,0.5], teacher_time 0.5, assignment_element_cost 0.5, dose native_rms_ratio 0.66 and pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, 20 local atom slots, 6 supplied pocket sites. The frozen function and support are preserved unchanged; no redesign is proposed. The confirmation test is native completion on the configured larger/new prior pool.
contrast_definition: Frozen numerical guidance versus no guidance with matched saved priors, random streams, checkpoint and native protocol on the configured larger/new pool. Both remain pocket-conditioned; chemical graphs are free. This is not a numerical intervention versus the frozen parent.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, on the configured larger/new pool with matched priors, random streams, checkpoint and native protocol, the frozen program fails to retain its measured execution response (for example near-zero nonzero updates or clipping) or does not meet the frozen tail utility primary with the affinity mean guard relative to the matched unguided pool.
observable_definition: Implemented and derivative-tested: local Hungarian assignment, robust per-point distance to observed teacher coordinates. Units A; no chemical-role or energy assumption.
predicted_execution_response: Measured parent response is the reference: 40 active and 40 nonzero updates, mean injected RMS about 0.0299 A, mean point RMS about 0.269 A, zero atom and cumulative clipping, assignment-switch fraction mean about 0.0167, and mean current-gradient RMS about 0.0078. On the larger/new pool the same frozen program is expected to produce a comparable nonzero-update and dose profile; this is a measured current-program response, not a terminal-affinity gradient.
predicted_terminal_response: On the configured larger/new pool the frozen program is expected to remain at or above the matched unguided pool on the frozen tail utility primary with the affinity mean guard. The existing 24-sample parent outcome (U_tau 0.0189, best qualified pIC50 8.589, mean all pIC50 7.842, hit fraction 0.042, 0 above target) is a prior-pool measurement and is not a forecast for new samples.
relationship_to_previous_failed_interven: Prior rollbacks (R04, R08_v2, R10_v2, R12_v2, R14_v2, R17_v2) were heterogeneous interventions on a reused prior pool, not independent replicates or isolated operator effects. The frozen confirmation keeps the exact R15_v2 function and support and changes only the evaluation pool, so it does not repeat those numerical interventions; the cross-condition families remain counterevidence for universal operator or region effects rather than for this frozen-program confirmation.
scientific_hypothesis: The frozen pointwise local-assignment guidance, run to native completion on the configured larger/new prior pool, retains its measured execution response and yields terminal affinity at least as good as the matched unguided pool, without requiring any change to the frozen function or support.
